title: Authority refusal body (contract 04)
description: The JSON body of the 403 the connector (or the hub, when it pre-checks) answers a refused request with (C-04.20). It is lib/core/remote-policy.js refusalBody's shape ({ok:false, remote:true, hint, mirror?}, web-chat-dev.worktrees/ae-int), which the chrome already reads to tell a remote refusal from any other 403, plus one `authority` object. A refused WebSocket upgrade carries the same body on its HTTP refusal (lib/portal/ws-relay.js refuseUpgrade). The daemon's own refusals keep their shapes (lib/server/audience.js requireMirror: {ok:false, mirror, remote, hint}).

remote.description: Refused because the request came through the hub, as refusalBody says for the portal.

hint.description: What would let this principal in, in the hub's words (for example: ask the chat's owner for Message), never a host command the viewer cannot run. host_only and retired rows say the act happens on the machine itself, or that the page predates an upgrade.

mirror.description: The daemon level this principal holds, when the refusal is for a level (reason 'level'), as refusalBody adds it for a 'mirror' refusal.

need.description: The table level the matched row needs, or null for a default deny or a malformed path.

requires.description: The specifics the row needs that the decision lacks (reason 'requires').

rule.description: The row that decided, as remote-policy keyOf() prints it, or null for a default deny.

decision_id.description: The decision the request was judged with, or null when there was none current (reason 'expired' or 'no-decision').
